# Sensitivity: corrected tradition labels (generated by analysis/make_numbers.py; supplement S4)

## Corrected labels

| item | field | published value | corrected value | decided | reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NEU_001 | tradition | Old Norse kenning (skaldic poetry) | Old English kenning | 2026-10-25 | host forms are Old English (hronrád, Beowulf l. 10) |
| NEU_001 | language | Old Norse | Old English | 2026-11-01* | host forms are Old English (hronrád, Beowulf l. 10) |

\* The language correction was added on 2026-11-01. When the item was judged again in the source audit (2026-10-25), only the tradition correction was applied; the language was sent as `Old Norse`.

## Verdicts under three groupings of the tradition intercept

Main set (condition C, k = 10; condition D: items with 10 kept controls). Mixed model pull ~ 1 + (1 | tradition), REML; one-sided Wald z; Holm across the 3 models; supported if p < .05. Published = the labels of `data/blind_items.csv` (the main analysis). Corrected (own group) = the reference of this sensitivity analysis, as requested before it was run.

† Chosen after the results were seen: NEU_001 joined to the existing label of the same tradition.
